Yotsuba Framework running MonoGame with Metal on Apple
Yotsuba Framework gives MonoGame projects a direct route to Metal on macOS, iPadOS and iOS.
The framework keeps the XNA-shaped API and the content pipeline developers already understand, while the Apple backend handles the platform-specific rendering work underneath.
Same code, more performance — with Apple hardware as a first-class destination.

Build around a shared game project and target Mac, iPad and iPhone through an Apple-native graphics path. The result is a focused workflow for bringing existing MonoGame ideas to Apple devices without abandoning the framework model.
